FULL_48_HGB.final_policy: Generate final-cohort probabilities once with the original frozen Stage 17B model and DEV_TRAIN-derived representation references; do not refit.
FULL_48_HGB.stage23b_refit_policy: The DEV_TRAIN+DEV_VAL Stage 23B refit and its committed final score are historical Study 1 context only and are not the paired Stage 27B comparator.

DIRECT_SUMMARY_DISTRIBUTION_HGB.role: Mechanistic control for distribution aggregation without learned encoding
DIRECT_SUMMARY_DISTRIBUTION_HGB.final_policy: Generate final-cohort probabilities once with the frozen checkpoint; do not refit.

fairness_assessment.population: DEV_TRAIN only for LATENT, FULL_48, and DIRECT
fairness_assessment.classifier_consistency: All primary methods use the frozen HGB policy; LATENT and DIRECT checkpoints use the same HGB configuration, and FULL_48 uses the established Stage 17B HGB.
fairness_assessment.intended_difference: Representational information: learned latent distributions versus engineered FULL_48 versus direct SUMMARY_17 distributions.
fairness_assessment.known_limit: FULL_48 contains chronology and persistence features unavailable to the permutation-invariant distribution representations.
fairness_assessment.threshold_metrics: Not part of the primary comparison; no final-cohort threshold selection is allowed.
